items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I noticed Mr. Kimball, Narvin Kimball, some people call him Henry Kimball, Jr., plays left-handed too. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Just like it is.

ctx.x: Yeah, I can't just recall all of them. Even down to Kildee, you know Kildee? You mentioned that. Yeah, when I work with our... They have a fellow, a little youngster. He was pretty good. He went into TB and he came. I think he's in Biloxi in the hospital or something. Nah, I can't recall his name.

Well, I think I was going to ask about the left-handed bass. You're a left-handed bass player. I noticed Mr. Kimball, Narvin Kimball, some people call him Henry Kimball, Jr., plays left-handed too. I wonder, did you ever change... Is your bass changed over? Did you change the sound post or anything? Or how do you do that?
